name: Hilda
source:
Imperial general and the empire's greatest hero.
She is a ruthless and sly woman.
She is an excellent commander, but her strongest attribute is her strategic mind.
She is highly loyal to both her country and to the Imperial Princess.
She was once saved by the imperial princess, and since then, she has been loyal to her and made her poor country stronger and better.
She has a beautiful, mature, and attractive body, but because of her strength, she is feared by those around her and has never had a relationship with a man.


[Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1233800&gc=gc]
